audit.whatIsWrong: Six fields tell the player Karma's root is Mantra-Q — whys[3] 'her Mantra-Q root', mid 'hold or bait it for her Mantra-Q (RQ) root ... if her RQ is down', spikes[2] 'if you reach her with Mantra-Q (RQ) on cooldown', wants.you[0] 'Hold Riposte for her Mantra-Q (RQ) root', wants.you[2] 'her RQ is on cooldown', wants.foe[1] 'Root you with Mantra-Q (RQ)'. Mantra-Q applies no root at all.
audit.why: Kit text, Q: 'a ball of spirit energy that explodes and deals damage ... Mantra Bonus: ... creating a cataclysm which deals damage after a short delay.' Damage only. The root is W, Focused Resolve: 'creates a tether between herself and a targeted enemy ... If the tether is not broken, the enemy will be rooted and damaged again.' The whole page's win condition — hold Riposte for the root — was pointed at the wrong spell, so a player following it parries a damage skillshot and eats the actual root. The full layer had it right all along ('Her root tether — breaks if you LoS / outrange it'), which makes the two layers contradict each other.
audit.corrected: Every reference repointed to Focused Resolve, with its flat 12s cooldown attached so the all-in window is timed. Breaking the tether by line of sight or range is the other out, and the full layer already says so.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing says Mantra-W heals her, so extended trades quietly reverse with no explanation.
audit.why: _missing/fiora.json flags needs-antiheal for Focused Resolve. Kit text: 'Mantra Bonus: Karma strengthens the link, healing herself and extending the root duration.' So her Mantra root is both longer AND a heal — the two things that beat Fiora's chip pattern.
audit.corrected: Named Grievous Wounds against Mantra-W in the mid text and in the no-Vitals don't.

audit.whatIsWrong: The chart calls levels 4-5 and 6 even and gives Fiora two items, while whys[3] and whys[4] describe her winning both mid stages and whys[6] says 'she out-scales you, so the lane has to be won before then'. Packet levelChart: Skill / Fiora x5 / Karma.
audit.why: Karma has no dash — only Inspire's move speed — so once Fiora is in range with Lunge refunding off Vital procs, the mid levels are hers. Level 6 is hers too because Mantra is not a power ultimate: it is available from level 1 and merely empowers the next spell. The late game genuinely belongs to a full-AP Karma poking from 950 range.
audit.corrected: Levels 4-5 and 6 -> Fiora; 2+ items -> Karma; Level 1 stays Skill. Flipped as one atomic group in both layers, and the final rating line changed from 'Even' to 'Favoured' so it stops contradicting the FAV diff enum.

audit.why: Four spikes present and honestly placed. Worth noting the page never claims Karma has a level-6 spike, which is right — Mantra is available at level 1 and costs no skill point, on a 40/38/36/34s cooldown reduced further by Gathering Fire whenever she lands damage. Inner Flame is 9/8/7/6/5s, Focused Resolve a flat 12s, Inspire 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s.
Packet suspectName "Inner Flame's" is a FALSE POSITIVE — correct ability name in possessive form. No change.

notes: Most serious error in my whole slice: six content fields identified Karma's root as Mantra-Q. Mantra-Q is a delayed damage cataclysm with no crowd control; the root is Focused Resolve (W), a 12s tether that roots if it is not broken by line of sight or by leaving its range. The page's entire win condition is 'hold Riposte for the root', so it was aiming the player's single most important cooldown at the wrong spell — and the full layer's breakdown.cooldowns already described Focused Resolve correctly, meaning the two layers on the same page disagreed. All six repointed. Second find: Mantra-W heals her while extending the root, which is the anti-heal case _missing flagged and which nothing on the page mentioned. Also note Mantra needs no skill point and is up from level 1, so there is no 'level 6 spike' for Karma — the page correctly never claimed one, but phases[4].why on the full layer still says 'Karma's ultimate changes the math too', which is wrong in the same way it was for Jayce; I did not have room to fix it inside its band after spending the budget on the root corrections.
